positions.title: SAT Team Leader
positions.description: Managed and trained group of 8 volunteer tutors to prepare 20 low-income Bronx students each year for the SATs, resulting in average score increase of 230 points, with a high increase of 510 points by a personal student.  Developed Ruby on Rails application for score analysis, lesson planning, and student communication.  Chosen for Leadership Council to guide direction of program and share best practices

positions.title: Participant
positions.description: Improved programming skills by spending 3 months in an intensive, collaborative learning environment.  Focused on strengthening Ruby knowledge, web development, and algorithms.
